theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_cub_bilinear_basis_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (L : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup L] [NormedSpace ℝ L] [FiniteDimensional ℝ L], ∃ (N : ℕ) (E : Fin N → L) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c ∧ (∀ (B : L →L[ℝ] L →L[ℝ] ℝ) (P Q : L), |B P Q| ≤ c * (∑ r, ∑ t, |B (E r) (E t)|) * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) ∧ ∀ (B B' : L →L[ℝ] L →L[ℝ] ℝ) (P Q : L), |B P Q - B' P Q| ≤ c * (∑ r, ∑ t, |B (E r) (E t) - B' (E r) (E t)|) * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖
